summary.description: HCH has eight isomers, with gamma-HCH (lindane) used as an insecticide mainly for timber. Pure lindane is a white solid with a slightly musty smell.
emission_sources: Use of gamma-HCH (lindane) as an insecticide in agriculture and timber treatment
environmental_impact: Exposure to background levels is unlikely to cause health issues, but operational exposure (especially agricultural) has reported adverse effects.
Gamma-HCH released into aquatic systems harms insects and fish.
Gamma-HCH bioaccumulates in fatty tissues of fish and the environment, leading to long-range environmental transport and effects distant from the release site.

top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Gamma-HCH accumulates in aquatic organisms, harming insects and fish, and spreads through water bodies causing long-distance ecological damage.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Exposure to lindane in agricultural or operational settings can cause adverse health effects in humans.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Continued use and release of gamma-HCH as an insecticide highlights the need for sustainable pesticide management and reduced harmful chemical production.
